title: Driver Licence and Vehicle Insurance Renewals on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Renewed documents on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts — a driver licence or vehicle insurance — are recorded on these terms.

**Clause.** A renewed driver licence or vehicle insurance document is accepted only when its expiry date is after the date it is recorded, and it replaces the expiry date on file. Documents are recorded for accounts in any status except closed. Recording a renewed document on an account deactivated for documents expired does not by itself reactivate it; reactivation follows the reactivation terms of the contractor account.

## Statuses in which a document can be recorded

| Account status | Renewed document recorded |
|---|---|
| Applied | Yes |
| Screening | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| On hold | Yes |
| Deactivated | Yes |
| Closed | No |

## Document grace days by level

While a licence or insurance expiry date has passed, the account stays active for the level's grace days awaiting the renewed document:

| Level | Grace days |
|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 0 (no vehicle document required) |
| Full-Service Shopper, Silver, Gold | 7 |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum, Diamond | 14 |

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- A renewed insurance document with an expiry date of 30 November is presented on 12 November: the expiry date is after the recording date, so it is accepted and replaces the expiry date on file.
- A document whose expiry date is 12 November, presented on 12 November, is not after the recording date and is not accepted.
- A renewed licence recorded on a deactivated account: it is recorded, and the account stays deactivated until reactivated under the reactivation terms.
